turns.text: how does my hospital software know when a patient searches for their records in the PHR app

must_contain: ABDM posts a discovery request to your HIP bridge at /api/v3/hip/patient/care-context/discover with the patient's name, gender, year of birth and identifiers.
You answer through on-discover with only the care contexts that are not linked yet, echoing the request's transactionId.
notes: User initiated linking from the HIP side, asked in plain words.
